8746a8.risk_area: Pre-auth installer takeover / SSRF via test-db / env write
8746a8.evidence: Installer lane completed dynamically by the Installer Surface Analyst (2026-11-08 17:20): lock logic, env-writer, and CLI provisioning verified hardened and ruled out with named controls (lock re-checked on all four installer routes; .env writer escapes/rejects newlines; flock'd storage/installing.lock closes TOCTOU; createInstructor blocks existing-account takeover). history.evidence: Installer gated by isAlreadyProvisioned() (lock file + instructor-exists fallback) on show/requirements/test-db/install; install lock via flock'd storage/installing.lock. test-db blocks 169.254/16 + IPv4-mapped IPv6 metadata IPs and returns generic errors (explicit anti-oracle comment at InstallerService.php:258-260). Superseded by detailed entries 4e903a/61dfca/2332d4/9316a6/ef929f/54d25e/55c464.

61dfca.risk_area: .env injection / newline injection of arbitrary env vars (APP_DEBUG flip, cache driver change)
61dfca.evidence: Dynamically tested the vendored phpdotenv parser (vendor/vlucas/phpdotenv): newlines inside quoted values are re-joined by the multiline processor, so "DB_PASSWORD=x\nAPP_DEBUG=true" stays one value and cannot inject new variables; formatEnvValue's addcslashes escapes quotes/backslashes/$; lone trailing backslash doesn't swallow following lines. Both append and preg_replace update paths tested. No APP_DEBUG/APP_KEY/SESSION_DRIVER flip, no code-exec path.

2332d4.risk_area: SSRF / internal port scan oracle + link-local guard bypass + worker-exhaustion DoS
2332d4.evidence: hex 0xa9fea9fe and octal 0177.0.0.1 and trailing-dot 169.254.169.254. bypass the link-local guard and PDO connects (proved via TCP listener at 169.254.169.254:3306 logging a real connection from the server); silent-open ports hang the worker indefinitely (PDO::ATTR_TIMEOUT does not bound the initial read), wedging the whole artisan-serve deployment; closed vs open ports are distinguishable (0.04s vs hang). Fix applied and verified. Report filed.

9316a6.surface: SQLite path handling (InstallerService::sanitizeSqlitePath + testDatabase sqlite branch)

ef929f.risk_area: CLI/web lock artifact mismatch (CLI install leaving web installer open)

54d25e.risk_area: Host-header poisoning of APP_URL default / installer wizard
54d25e.evidence: X-Forwarded-Host flows into request()->getSchemeAndHttpHost() (trustProxies '*') and is reflected as the default app_url in the installer wizard (verified live: app_url: 'https://probe.invalid.example' vs control 'http://127.0.0.1:8099'). Blade {{ }} entity-encodes quotes so JS-string breakout is blocked; backslash-only Host values self-DoS the response. It only prefills the visible field and the operator must complete the 6-step install, so it is a social-engineering/UX weakness, not a direct ATO. Not filed as a vulnerability; fix would be pinning app.url default instead of request-derived host.

184575.surface: Instructor/training workflow surfaces (submissions, progress, queue broadcast, sandbox reset, spectate) — business logic
184575.risk_area: Business logic (workflow bypass, state manipulation, multi-step flows: submissions/grading, progress, queue broadcast, sandbox reset, spectate)
